title: API Gateway with Lambda
description: Build serverless APIs with API Gateway and Lambda in C#.

data.text: API Gateway exposes HTTP endpoints that trigger Lambda functions. This replaces traditional web servers for many backend APIs, giving you auto-scaling and pay-per-request billing.

data.title: Create an API Gateway route and deploy
data.content:
Package: AWSSDK.ApiGateway
Use the AWS SDK to create REST APIs, resources, methods, and deployments.

data.title: Parse an API Gateway request in C#
data.content: Use Amazon.Lambda.APIGatewayEvents to receive HTTP events.

data.title: CORS
data.text: If your API is called from a browser, enable CORS in API Gateway. Add an OPTIONS method and Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers so the browser allows the request.

data.title: Deploy a serverless orders API
data.description: Create a GET /orders/{orderId} endpoint backed by Lambda.
steps: Create an API Gateway REST API
Integrate the method with a Lambda function

data.expectedOutcome: A publicly accessible endpoint returns JSON from the Lambda function.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: API Gateway maps HTTP requests to Lambda invocations
Lambda handles the business logic in C#
Deploy stages separate dev, test, and prod
CORS must be configured for browser clients
data.takeaway: API Gateway + Lambda replaces traditional controllers and servers with a fully managed HTTP tier.
